98069877.s: A traditional restaurant serving Saudi home-style dishes with international recipes and a distinctive flavor. Open 11:00 am to 12:00 am; phone 0536001963.
98069877.b: Herman Restaurant serves traditional Saudi dishes with international recipes and a distinctive flavor. It is known for kabsa, mandi and madhbi, and has a decor that blends traditional character with modern comfort, including nicely lit upper seating areas. Phone: 0536001963. Open from 11:00 am to 12:00 midnight.
98069877.a: Al Samer District, Al Rabie, Jeddah 23461

98069876.s: One of Jeddah's best-known breakfast restaurants, serving a variety of traditional dishes. Open 5:00 am to 2:00 am; phone 0558291243.
98069876.b: Abu Zaid Restaurants is one of the best-known breakfast spots in Jeddah, serving a variety of traditional dishes. It is known for foul, tamees bread and mutabbaq, and is so popular that it is always full, although some visitors comment on service and packaging quality at peak times. Phone: 0558291243. Open from 5:00 am to 2:00 am.

98069854.s: A traditional restaurant serving a wide range of Saudi and Arabic dishes. Open 11:30 am to 12:30 am; phone 920003572.
98069854.b: Sarmad is a traditional restaurant serving a wide range of Saudi and Arabic dishes in a style that recalls the old days, with meals served on the floor in private rooms. It is known for mandi, fakhir and marsa, offers a complimentary welcome soup, and has a floor dedicated to families and a spacious, clean atmosphere, although parking can sometimes be hard to find. Phone: 920035728. Open from 11:00 am to 1:00 am.
98069854.a: Muhammad ibn Abdulwahhab Street, Al Baghdadiyah Al Sharqiyah, Jeddah 22235

98069853.s: One of Jeddah's historic landmarks, on Gold Street, famous for its delicious brown bread baked the same way for generations. Open 6:00 am to 11:08 pm; phone 0543008620.
98069853.b: Forn Al Sheikh is one of Jeddah's historic landmarks. It is located on Gold Street and is famous for its delicious brown bread, baked the same way for generations. The smell of fresh bread greets you as soon as you walk in, and longtime Jeddah residents, even those who have moved abroad, return again and again out of nostalgia for its distinctive taste. Phone: 0543008620. Open from 6:00 am to 11:08 pm.
98069853.a: 7200 Gold Street, Al Balad District, Jeddah 22233

98069852.s: Traditional food and authentic Taif-style saleeq. Open 12:30 pm to 1:00 am; phone 0557690991.
98069852.b: Saleeq Omi serves traditional food and authentic Taif-style saleeq. It is a small place that prepares quick orders to a high standard, and it is also known for its samosas at a symbolic price (1.5 riyals), although nearby parking can sometimes be hard to find. Phone: 0557690991. Open from 12:30 pm to 1:00 am.

98069850.s: A wide selection of breakfast items and traditional dishes in a distinctive setting. Open 7:00 am to 11:00 pm; phone 0567076696.
98069850.b: Tatemat Jastaniah offers a wide selection of breakfast items and traditional dishes, with an atmosphere and seating that recall the traditional Hijazi home. It is known for jallabah dishes and lamb brain, has elegant decor that reflects the character of the region, and is an immersive cultural destination for tourists and visitors. Phone: 0567076696. Open from 7:00 am to 11:00 pm.

98069848.s: Located in Souq Al Nada in historic Jeddah, famous for fresh seafood served in a simple, hospitable setting. Open 12:15 pm to 11:00 pm; phone 0503674710.
98069848.b: Ba'eshen Seafood Restaurant is located in Souq Al Nada in the historic Jeddah area and is known for fresh seafood served in a simple, hospitable setting. It is regarded as the number one place to try fish in the heart of old historic Jeddah, with reasonable prices and a friendly staff, although the seating area is relatively small and grilling is not available. Phone: 0503674710. Open from 12:15 pm to 11:00 pm.

98069847.s: A restaurant known for manti, farmuza and a varied pastry menu. Open 1:00 pm to 12:00 am; phone 0559217987.
98069847.b: Bait Al Turkistani is known for manti, farmuza and a varied pastry menu in the Afghan style. It is famous for its lamb manti and cheese farmuza, served in an economical portion (3 pieces for 2 riyals), and is especially appreciated for its authentic taste, although manti dishes are known to cause some bloating. Phone: 0559217987. Open from 1:00 pm to 12:00 midnight.

98069846.s: Specializes in maqluba with its authentic flavor, alongside many other tasty dishes. Open 11:00 am to 1:00 am; phone 0551383111.
98069846.b: Asqalan specializes in maqluba with its authentic flavor, alongside many other tasty dishes. It is known for chicken, meat and macaroni maqluba and for biryani, and has excellent reviews for the quality of its presentation and the variety of its menu, despite its simplicity. Phone: 0551383111. Open from 11:00 am to 2:00 am.
98069846.a: Prince Saud Al Faisal Road, Al Rawdah, Jeddah 23432

98069845.s: A traditional restaurant specializing in Saudi home cooking. Open 11:00 am to 12:30 am; phone 0126677763.
98069845.b: Al Sadda is a traditional restaurant specializing in authentic Saudi dishes. It serves traditional meals at reasonable prices in a clean, comfortable setting, and visitors give it excellent reviews for the quality of its rice and meat and the warm welcome from the team. Phone: 0126677763. Open from 11:00 am to 1:00 am.
98069845.a: Prince Sultan Road, Al Nahdah, Jeddah 23615

98069843.s: A fish and traditional food restaurant known for varied dishes such as fried fish. Open 1:00 pm to 11:30 pm; phone 0504301163.
98069843.b: Albasali Seafood is a fish and traditional food restaurant known for varied dishes such as fried fish. It is famous for fried najil, crispy shrimp and Siyadiyah rice, and is considered one of the best-known fish restaurants in Jeddah, although heavy demand can mean waits of up to 50 minutes. Phone: 0504301163. Open from 1:00 pm to 11:30 pm.
98069843.a: Behind Al Falah Schools, Souq Bab Makkah, Historic Jeddah, Jeddah 22236

98069842.s: A restaurant serving Hijazi dishes such as sweet and savory mutabbaq and mu'asoub. Open 6:00 am to 11:59 pm; phone 0550893552.
98069842.b: Al Qarmoshi serves Hijazi dishes such as sweet and savory mutabbaq and mu'asoub. It is known for authentic Hijazi breakfast dishes and is very busy, especially in the morning, although some visitors comment on the speed of service at peak times. Phone: 0550893552. Open from 5:50 am to 11:25 am and from 6:10 pm to 12:25 am.

98069841.s: One of the most famous and delicious kebab restaurants in Jeddah. Open 7:00 am to 1:30 am; phone 0535400766.
98069841.b: Naji Alharbi Kebab is one of the most famous and delicious kebab restaurants in Jeddah. It is known for grilled dishes and grilled meat with an authentic flavor, and serves large platters suited to groups. Some branches have no chairs or seating, so takeaway is recommended. Phone: 0535400766. Open from 11:00 am to 2:00 am.

98069840.s: A traditional kitchen known for varied dishes such as traditional Hijazi saleeq. Open 10:00 am to 11:00 pm; phone 0126940945.
98069840.b: Matbakh Humam is a traditional kitchen known for varied dishes such as traditional Hijazi saleeq. It is advisable to call ahead to order, because the restaurant mostly handles takeaway orders and has no air-conditioned waiting area. Saleeq is served with a minimum of one whole chicken, so large orders need to be booked hours in advance. Phone: 0126940945. Open from 10:00 am to 3:00 pm and from 5:00 pm to 11:00 pm.

98069838.s: Known for crispy falafel and traditional dishes. Open 6:30 am to 12:00 am; phone 0126306293.
98069838.b: Falafel Al Khalidiyah is known for crispy falafel and traditional dishes, and, according to locals, is part of the legend of old Jeddah. It is famous for its falafel sandwich with hummus and a distinctive hot sauce, and is always crowded, especially at breakfast time. It offers takeaway only, with no seating area. Phone: 0126306293. Open from 6:30 am to 12:00 noon and from 5:00 pm to 12:00 midnight.
98069838.a: Nour Al Yusr, Al Khalidiyah, Jeddah 23423

98069785.s: The first museum of its kind in Saudi Arabia, with nearly 1,000 rare pieces. Open 10:00 am to 10:00 pm.
98069785.b: Al Maktain Museum is the first museum of its kind in Saudi Arabia, with nearly 1,000 rare pieces spread across four museums in one place: the history of Islamic art, the history of Islamic medicine, photography of Makkah and Madinah, and major historical milestones. It has excellent signage in Arabic and English and high-quality exhibits, and visitors widely praise the richness of its educational content. Open from 10:00 am to 10:00 pm.
98069785.a: Al Aziziyah, Prince Muhammad ibn Abdulaziz Street, Jeddah 23334

98069783.s: A museum presenting the career of the great artist Tariq Abdulhakim in art and music, with an interactive music hall. Open 9:00 am to 10:00 pm.
98069783.b: The Tariq Abdulhakim Center is a museum presenting the career of the great artist Tariq Abdulhakim in art and music, and it includes an interactive music hall where visitors can try the instruments themselves. It is located in the heart of historic Jeddah (Al Balad) and offers a free guided tour of about 20 minutes in Arabic and English. Abdulhakim won the UNESCO International Music Prize in 1981, the first Arab to do so. Admission is free. Open from 9:00 am to 10:00 pm.

98069756.s: A sandy swimming beach suitable for everyone, offering many marine activities and services. Open 6:00 am to 10:00 pm.
98069756.b: Kokiyan is a sandy swimming beach suitable for everyone, offering many marine activities and services. It has areas set aside for families and children, a clean atmosphere and clear water, and chairs and tables can be rented. Shisha is also available. Open from 6:00 am to 10:00 pm.

98069754.s: A complete experience: relax on the beach and enjoy the sun. Open 8:00 am to 1:00 am; phone 920002828.
98069754.b: La Playa Beach is a complete experience: relax on the beach and enjoy the sunshine, with a well-known seafood restaurant directly overlooking the sea. It is known for its grouper and fresh calamari, and has exceptional hospitality for breakfast and dinner, with a minimum spend of 300 riyals. Phone: 920002828. Open from 8:00 am to 1:00 am.
98069754.a: Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Street, North Obhur, Jeddah 23811

98069753.s: One of the quietest beaches in Jeddah, several kilometers from the city center, where you can get close to the waves and gaze at the horizon. Open 24 hours; phone 0566622849.
98069753.b: Buhairat Beach is one of the quietest beaches in Jeddah, since it is several kilometers from the city center and lets you get close to the waves and gaze at the horizon. It is known for its privacy and high level of cleanliness, and is admired by visitors looking for a calm beach experience away from the bustle of crowded beaches. Phone: 0566622849.

98069751.s: One of the most beautiful beaches overlooking central Jeddah, thanks to its crescent shape.
98069751.b: Obhur Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches overlooking central Jeddah because of its crescent shape. It has sand-covered play areas for children and two swimming areas, along with a clean, refreshing atmosphere suited to family evenings. Ice cream and coffee shops are expected to open soon.

98069750.s: A marine site near the beaches where visitors can camp or enjoy a quick boat trip. Open 24 hours.
98069750.b: King Salman Bay is a marine site near the beaches where visitors can easily camp or enjoy a quick boat trip. Its views are beautiful, especially at sunrise and in the late afternoon, and it has great potential to develop into a marine tourism destination in the future.

98069749.s: Lets visitors sit on the beach, swim in the Red Sea and enjoy events and activities held on the beach. Phone: 0122341871.
98069749.b: Sheraton Beach lets visitors sit on the beach, swim in the Red Sea and enjoy the events and activities held there. It is located in a villa resort in North Obhur and offers a relaxing atmosphere with a refreshing sea breeze, although some visitors note that the beach needs more maintenance and that water cleanliness could be improved. Phone: 0122341871.
98069749.a: Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Street, Al Lulu, Jeddah 23821

98069748.s: An integrated leisure area on the Jeddah seafront combining a variety of restaurants and distinctive cafes. Open 4:00 pm to 3:00 am.
98069748.b: Jeddah Promenade is an integrated leisure area on the Jeddah seafront combining a variety of restaurants and distinctive cafes. It offers organized walking paths, open spaces and public artworks overlooking the Red Sea, and is an ideal family destination, especially in the evening at sunset, although parking is crowded on weekends. Open from 4:00 pm to 3:00 am.

98069747.s: Experience the tropical rainforest in Jeddah, a fun leisure area for the whole family. Open 10:00 am to 11:00 pm; phone 920013725.
98069747.b: Tropical Land lets you experience the tropical rainforest in Jeddah, a fun leisure area for the whole family. Visitors can interact directly with colorful tropical birds and see flamingos and small animals such as iguanas and snakes, in an air-conditioned setting that recreates a real jungle. Phone: 920013725. Open from 12:00 noon to 11:30 pm.
